newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia boat sinks, at least 60 dead.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia boat sinks, at least 60 dead.

text.p: At least 60 people were reported dead after a boat carrying 200 passengers sank in a lake in Indonesia's north Sumatra province, newspapers and official media reported on Tuesday.
Kompas newspaper reported K.M. Peldatari sank on Monday night on its way from Parapat town on the shore of lake Toba to Tomok on the island of Samosir, which is in the middle of the lake.
